audit_events_actor_matches_source.name: audit_events_actor_matches_source
audit_events_actor_matches_source.value:
("hris"."audit_events"."source" = 'USER' and "hris"."audit_events"."actor_account_id" is not null and "hris"."audit_events"."job_name" is null)
      or ("hris"."audit_events"."source" = 'JOB' and "hris"."audit_events"."job_name" is not null)

employment_events_notice_only_resigned.name: employment_events_notice_only_resigned
employment_events_notice_only_resigned.value: ("hris"."employment_events"."resignation_notice" is not null) = ("hris"."employment_events"."reason_kind" is not distinct from 'RESIGNED')

field_permits_revoke_complete.name: field_permits_revoke_complete
field_permits_revoke_complete.value: ("hris"."field_permits"."revoked_at" is null) = ("hris"."field_permits"."revoke_reason" is null) and ("hris"."field_permits"."revoked_at" is null) = ("hris"."field_permits"."revoked_by_account_id" is null)

training_reviews_shape.name: training_reviews_shape
training_reviews_shape.value:
case "hris"."training_reviews"."decision"
      when 'APPROVE' then "hris"."training_reviews"."promotion_effective_on" is not null and "hris"."training_reviews"."placement_id" is not null and "hris"."training_reviews"."review_again_on" is null
      else "hris"."training_reviews"."review_again_on" is not null and "hris"."training_reviews"."reason" is not null and btrim("hris"."training_reviews"."reason") <> '' and "hris"."training_reviews"."placement_id" is null end

setting_values_cancel_complete.name: setting_values_cancel_complete
setting_values_cancel_complete.value:
("hris"."setting_values"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("hris"."setting_values"."cancelled_at" is not null)
      and ("hris"."setting_values"."cancelled_at" is null or ("hris"."setting_values"."cancelled_by_account_id" is not null and btrim(coalesce("hris"."setting_values"."cancel_reason", '')) <> ''))

attendance_corrections_state.name: attendance_corrections_state
attendance_corrections_state.value: ("hris"."attendance_corrections"."in_at" is null) = ("hris"."attendance_corrections"."branch_id" is null) and ("hris"."attendance_corrections"."out_at" is null or "hris"."attendance_corrections"."in_at" is not null)

attendance_records_proof.name: attendance_records_proof
attendance_records_proof.value: "hris"."attendance_records"."kind" = 'BREAK' or ("hris"."attendance_records"."latitude" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."longitude" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."distance_m" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."photo_file_id" is not null and "hris"."attendance_records"."attempt_id" is not null)

leave_movements_adjust_reason.name: leave_movements_adjust_reason
leave_movements_adjust_reason.value: "hris"."leave_movements"."kind" <> 'ADJUST' or ("hris"."leave_movements"."reason" is not null and btrim("hris"."leave_movements"."reason") <> '')

overtime_claims_hours.name: overtime_claims_hours
overtime_claims_hours.value: "hris"."overtime_claims"."claimed_hours" between 1 and 24 and ("hris"."overtime_claims"."approved_hours" is null or "hris"."overtime_claims"."approved_hours" between 1 and "hris"."overtime_claims"."claimed_hours")

overtime_claims_reduction.name: overtime_claims_reduction
overtime_claims_reduction.value: ("hris"."overtime_claims"."approved_hours" is not null and "hris"."overtime_claims"."approved_hours" < "hris"."overtime_claims"."claimed_hours") = ("hris"."overtime_claims"."reduction_reason" is not null)

swap_invitations_shape.name: swap_invitations_shape
swap_invitations_shape.value:
("hris"."swap_invitations"."kind" = 'DAY_OFF' and "hris"."swap_invitations"."from_pick_id" is not null and "hris"."swap_invitations"."to_pick_id" is not null)
      or ("hris"."swap_invitations"."kind" = 'SHIFT' and "hris"."swap_invitations"."from_date" = "hris"."swap_invitations"."to_date" and "hris"."swap_invitations"."from_shift_id" is not null and "hris"."swap_invitations"."to_shift_id" is not null)

work_shift_versions_break_complete.name: work_shift_versions_break_complete
work_shift_versions_break_complete.value:
("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_minutes" is null) = ("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_start_from" is null)
      and ("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_minutes" is null) = ("hris"."work_shift_versions"."break_start_until" is null)

bonus_entries_reason_needed.name: bonus_entries_reason_needed
bonus_entries_reason_needed.value: "hris"."bonus_entries"."status" not in ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED') or "hris"."bonus_entries"."reason" is not null

comparison_slips_rule.name: comparison_slips_rule
comparison_slips_rule.value: "hris"."comparison_slips"."cause" is distinct from 'INTENDED' or ("hris"."comparison_slips"."rule_ref" is not null and btrim("hris"."comparison_slips"."rule_ref") <> '')

driver_fines_approved.name: driver_fines_approved
driver_fines_approved.value: "hris"."driver_fines"."status" not in ('ACTIVE', 'WAIVED') or "hris"."driver_fines"."approved_at" is not null

driver_fines_ended.name: driver_fines_ended
driver_fines_ended.value: ("hris"."driver_fines"."status" in ('CANCELLED', 'WAIVED')) = ("hris"."driver_fines"."end_reason" is not null and "hris"."driver_fines"."ended_at" is not null)

other_deductions_money_check_pair.name: other_deductions_money_check_pair
other_deductions_money_check_pair.value: ("hris"."other_deductions"."money_check_source" is null) = ("hris"."other_deductions"."money_check_payment_id" is null) and ("hris"."other_deductions"."money_check_source" is null or "hris"."other_deductions"."money_check_source" in ('TRUCK', 'SELF'))

other_deductions_active_approved.name: other_deductions_active_approved
other_deductions_active_approved.value: "hris"."other_deductions"."status"::text not in ('ACTIVE', 'WAIVED') or "hris"."other_deductions"."approved_at" is not null

other_receivables_written_off.name: other_receivables_written_off
other_receivables_written_off.value: "hris"."other_receivables"."status" <> 'WRITTEN_OFF' or ("hris"."other_receivables"."reason" is not null and "hris"."other_receivables"."decided_at" is not null)

payslip_objections_approved.name: payslip_objections_approved
payslip_objections_approved.value: ("hris"."payslip_objections"."state" = 'APPROVED') = ("hris"."payslip_objections"."approved_at" is not null and "hris"."payslip_objections"."fix_path" is not null)

payslip_objections_linked.name: payslip_objections_linked
payslip_objections_linked.value: ("hris"."payslip_objections"."fix_status" = 'FIXED') = ("hris"."payslip_objections"."linked_at" is not null and "hris"."payslip_objections"."fix_kind" is not null)

payslip_payments_money.name: payslip_payments_money
payslip_payments_money.value: "hris"."payslip_payments"."kind" <> 'MONEY' or ("hris"."payslip_payments"."amount" > 0 and "hris"."payslip_payments"."batch_id" is not null and "hris"."payslip_payments"."money_place_id" is not null and "hris"."payslip_payments"."method" in ('CASH', 'TRANSFER'))

payslips_period_end.name: payslips_period_end
payslips_period_end.value: ("hris"."payslips"."kind" = 'MONTHLY') = ("hris"."payslips"."period_end" is null) and ("hris"."payslips"."period_end" is null or "hris"."payslips"."period_end" between "hris"."payslips"."period_start" and "hris"."payslips"."period_start" + 6)

payslips_closed_complete.name: payslips_closed_complete
payslips_closed_complete.value: "hris"."payslips"."status" <> 'CLOSED' or ("hris"."payslips"."number" is not null and "hris"."payslips"."net" is not null and "hris"."payslips"."closed_at" is not null and "hris"."payslips"."objection_until" is not null)

trip_wage_values_unrated.name: trip_wage_values_unrated
trip_wage_values_unrated.value: ("hris"."trip_wage_values"."status" <> 'UNRATED' or "hris"."trip_wage_values"."rate_id" is null) and ("hris"."trip_wage_values"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' or "hris"."trip_wage_values"."rate_id" is not null)

trip_wage_values_cancel.name: trip_wage_values_cancel
trip_wage_values_cancel.value: ("hris"."trip_wage_values"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("hris"."trip_wage_values"."cancelled_at" is not null and "hris"."trip_wage_values"."cancel_reason" is not null)

unloading_items_shape.name: unloading_items_shape
unloading_items_shape.value: ("hris"."unloading_items"."product_id" is not null and "hris"."unloading_items"."uom_id" is not null and "hris"."unloading_items"."quantity" > 0 and "hris"."unloading_items"."weight_kg" > 0 and "hris"."unloading_items"."other_reason" is null) or ("hris"."unloading_items"."product_id" is null and "hris"."unloading_items"."uom_id" is null and "hris"."unloading_items"."quantity" is null and "hris"."unloading_items"."weight_kg" is null and length(btrim(coalesce("hris"."unloading_items"."other_reason", ''))) >= 15)

unloading_overpayment_uses_refund.name: unloading_overpayment_uses_refund
unloading_overpayment_uses_refund.value: "hris"."unloading_overpayment_uses"."kind" <> 'REFUND' or ("hris"."unloading_overpayment_uses"."money_place_id" is not null and "hris"."unloading_overpayment_uses"."money_date" is not null)

unloading_payments_money.name: unloading_payments_money
unloading_payments_money.value: "hris"."unloading_payments"."kind" <> 'MONEY' or ("hris"."unloading_payments"."amount" > 0 and "hris"."unloading_payments"."money_place_id" is not null and "hris"."unloading_payments"."method" in ('CASH', 'TRANSFER'))

unloading_reports_active_branch.name: unloading_reports_active_branch
unloading_reports_active_branch.value: "hris"."unloading_reports"."status" not in ('ACTIVE', 'PAID') or ("hris"."unloading_reports"."cost_branch_id" is not null and "hris"."unloading_reports"."activated_at" is not null)

advance_handovers_cancelled.name: advance_handovers_cancelled
advance_handovers_cancelled.value: ("hris"."advance_handovers"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("hris"."advance_handovers"."cancelled_at" is not null and "hris"."advance_handovers"."cancel_reason" is not null)

advance_installments_period.name: advance_installments_period
advance_installments_period.value: "hris"."advance_installments"."period_start" is null or "hris"."advance_installments"."slip_kind" = 'WEEKLY' or extract(day from "hris"."advance_installments"."period_start") = 26

advance_movements_slip.name: advance_movements_slip
advance_movements_slip.value: "hris"."advance_movements"."kind" not in ('SLIP', 'TO_RECEIVABLE') or "hris"."advance_movements"."payslip_id" is not null

advances_amounts.name: advances_amounts
advances_amounts.value:
"hris"."advances"."requested_amount" > 0 and "hris"."advances"."requested_installments" >= 1
      and ("hris"."advances"."final_amount" is null or ("hris"."advances"."final_amount" > 0 and "hris"."advances"."final_amount" <= "hris"."advances"."requested_amount"))
      and ("hris"."advances"."review_amount" is null or ("hris"."advances"."review_amount" > 0 and "hris"."advances"."review_amount" <= "hris"."advances"."requested_amount"))

advances_approved_final.name: advances_approved_final
advances_approved_final.value: "hris"."advances"."state" <> 'APPROVED' or ("hris"."advances"."final_amount" is not null and "hris"."advances"."final_installments" is not null and "hris"."advances"."decided_at" is not null)

advances_closed_reason.name: advances_closed_reason
advances_closed_reason.value: "hris"."advances"."state" not in ('CANCELLED') or ("hris"."advances"."close_reason" is not null and "hris"."advances"."closed_at" is not null)
